policy_name: Part-Time and Temporary Contract Worker Classification Policy
description: Vendor engagements structured as part-time contract or temporary staffing arrangements require a completed worker-classification risk assessment before spend is incurred, to guard against treating what is functionally part-time employment as an independent-contractor vendor relationship.

policy_references.notes: Sets statutory minimum protections for employees, including part-time, temporary, and casual workers (e.g. written particulars of employment, itemised pay statements, minimum notice of termination). Independent contractors fall outside these protections, which is exactly why accurate classification of a 'vendor' engagement matters. The Act does not specify a numeric weekly-hours threshold for part-time status, so misclassification_review_required_above_hours_per_week is an internal risk-management heuristic, not a legal citation-backed number.

Sets the hours-per-week review trigger. Must not be set so high that it would exclude engagements that would qualify as part-time employment under the Employment Rights Act, 2012 once a verified numeric threshold is confirmed.
